title: 🌸：彗醬～彗醬快點過來喔～ ☄️：有好多怪，啊牙敗了，啊牙敗了～啊啊！我可能要死了！ 🌸：啊彗醬，笨蛋，笨蛋⋯好了，彗醬死x1 ☄️：都是妳叫我拿東西過去那邊啦！ 🌸：不要亂怪別人…
context:
🌸：彗醬～彗醬快點過來喔～
☄️：有好多怪，啊牙敗了，啊牙敗了～啊啊！我可能要死了！
🌸：啊彗醬，笨蛋，笨蛋⋯好了，彗醬死x1
☄️：都是妳叫我拿東西過去那邊啦！
🌸：不要亂怪別人啊！
☄️：妳這傢伙，我以後晚上都不出來啦！
🌸：請彗桑說一下要反省的地方？
☄️：反省的地方就是以後有人求救我都不會去了。
🌸：所以妳現在是想說都是🌸的問題？
☄️：不是說都是🌸的問題啦，但下次就算被求救也不會去了～
🌸：啊不行了⋯這樣的反省⋯
🍙：有裂痕了wwww
🌸：啊算了⋯那就算了⋯既然這樣⋯以後🌸也不保護☄️啦！
☄️：那⋯妳剛才就該保護我啊！妳應該過來保護我的啊！
🥀：不要吵架！
🌽：不要吵架！
🌸：我剛才正要去保護妳的時候⋯妳就在我眼前死掉了啊！

🌸：Suichan~Suichan come here~
☄️：Too many mobs here, oh this is bad, this is bad, ahhh, I am going to die!
🌸：Suichan, ahhh you dumb, you so dumb, ok, Suichan dead x1
☄️：It’s all because you asked me to bring something over!
🌸：Don’t blame other people for your own failure!
☄️：Well I am never going out at night again !
🌸：Sui-san please make a self-reflection?
☄️：That will be, I am not coming out even when someone cries for help.
🌸：Are you saying this is my problem?
☄️：I wouldn’t say this is🌸’s problem, but my point is, I am not gonna help anyone in the future when they ask me to.
🌸：Errrr No, this self-reflection she is saying…
🍙：I sensed a crack wwww
🌸：Ohh whatever…whatever…fine then…I am not going to protect you neither !
☄️：Well…then you should have protected me back there! you were supposed to come here and protect me !
🥀：No fighting!
🌽：No fighting!
🌸：I was on my way to you! but you just died right before my eyes !
